description: This file defines the `ReportLine` class, which models a data record containing timestamp, MafValue, RpmValue, and wave information, along with accessor methods and a string representation.

classes.name: ReportLine
classes.description: A data structure representing a single report line with timestamp, MafValue, RpmValue, and wave information.

methods.name: ReportLine
methods.description: Constructor initializing all fields of the report line.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the report line.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Returns the MafValue object associated with this report line.

methods.name: getRpm
methods.description: Returns the RpmValue object associated with this report line.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the report line for debugging or logging.
